name: caveman
description: 🪨 why use many token when few token do trick — Claude Code skill that cuts 65% of tokens by talking like caveman
one_liner: A add-on for AI coding assistants that makes them 'talk' in short, blunt instructions internally to save money — cutting token usage without changing what code actually gets written.
buyer: A developer or team with a large monthly AI API bill who wants to cut costs without changing which model they use.
business_use_cases: A startup with heavy Claude Code usage installs it to reduce monthly API spend by roughly a third per the project's own benchmark.
An AI-tooling educator uses it as a talking point in cost-optimization content.
A dev-tools reviewer benchmarks it against competitors like ponytail for a comparison post that drives traffic.

money_ideas.idea: No real monetization for an outside operator — it's a free skill; value is the token savings it gives its own users.

steal_this: Write and publish a head-to-head cost/quality benchmark of caveman vs. ponytail vs. no skill on a real repo — that kind of content earns affiliate/consulting leads even though the tool itself isn't monetizable.
